question: Which of the following through its Micro Credit Innovations Department has continued its role as the facilitator of microfinance initiatives in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is "**NABARD**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***NABARD*** was founded on July 12, 1982, when the RBI transferred its agricultural credit and refinancing operations to the ***Agricultural Refinance and Development Corporation (ARDC).***
 
• Its ***mission*** was to advance prosperous, sustainable, and equitable agriculture and rural development through collaborative financial and non-financial interventions, technological advancements, and institutional growth.
 
• Through its*** Micro Credit Innovations Department***, NABARD has kept up its support of and mentoring of the nation's microfinance programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***The Self Help Group - Bank Linkage Program ***model was created by NABARD as a practical way to connect underserved and unreached impoverished households with financial services.
 
• NABARD is implementing and assisting in the implementation of a number of Government of India-announced Schemes, including the*** National Rural Livelihoods Mission*** (NRLM) of the Ministry of Rural Development and the Promotion of Women SHGS (WSHGs).
 
• So, it is safe to assume that ***NABARD*** supported the idea of Self Help Groups (SHGs) as a means of supporting the underprivileged.
